title: Homogeneous quotient action and coefficient projections (second)
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L invertible, J=j.ker with J²=0, and n≥0 [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Fix a TensorGradedPresentation T [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation] and the canonical comparison data D=(a_r,k_r) [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Set F=j^*(J⊗L^n), N=(j^*L)^n, H=H¹(Z,-) [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Fix e≥0, f:O_Z→N and x:O_Z→N^(e+1). Define s=c(f^⊗1), t=c(x), and Q_r=k_r^(-1)∘H¹(X,π_(n(r+1)),1), using the explicit homogeneous sections and degree projections [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-product-projection]. Suppose σ is a local quotient action on K satisfying i(σ(p(b))y)=b i(y) and commuting with restrictions, μ is its global endomorphism action, and ρ(g)=H¹(X,μ(g)). Then for every z∈H¹(X,K), Q_(e+1)(ρ(t)z)=H(ρ_F^(-1);id_F⊗x)(H(ρ_F)(Q_0(z))). This statement asserts only action compatibility, with no section boundary, resolution, or derivation identity.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and the direct-sum exact sequence following it; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, the quotient action in the first paragraph of its proof.

proof.text: Obtain the sheaf morphism identity for the second homogeneous action using tensorGradedAction_kernel_second. Apply H^1(X,-) and evaluate on z, using functoriality of the cohomology functor. Replace rho by H^1(mu) using haction.

Evaluate coefficient projections by tensorGradedCoefficientProjection_apply. Apply the general transported-kernel naturality square to v=id_F tensor x from exponent 0 to e+1. Cancel the right unitor followed by its inverse under H^1(Z,-); this proves the exact requested formula.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09MS graded ideal sequence and Tag 0B8S quotient action; sheaf action split from the fully proved comparison transport and cohomology/unitor calculation.

theorem tensorGradedAction_projection_second {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (n : ℕ) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D)
    (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n)
    (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n).tensorPow (e + 1))
    (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, T.C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (T.I.val.obj (op U)))
    (μ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+* End T.I)
    (ρ : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+*
      Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj T.I))
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U))
        (T.i.val.app (op U) (σ U (T.p.right.hom.app (op U) b) y)) =
        b * @id (T.B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (T.i.val.app (op U) y))
    (hrestrict : ∀ (U V : X.Opens) (a : V ⟶ U)
      (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      T.I.val.map a.op (σ U g y) = σ V (T.C.right.obj.map a.op g) (T.I.val.map a.op y))
    (hglobal : ∀ (g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens)
      (y : T.I.val.obj (op U)),
      (μ g).val.app (op U) y = σ U (T.C.right.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) y)
    (haction : ∀ g : T.C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤), ρ g =
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map (μ g)).hom) :
    let F : Z.Modules := (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)
    let N : Z.Modules := ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n
    let H := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Z.toRingedSpace 1
    (∀ z : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj T.I,
      tensorGradedCoefficientProjection T D (e + 1) (ρ (tensorGradedSection T D e x) z) =
      H.map ((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ x)
        (H.map (ρ_ F).hom (tensorGradedCoefficientProjection T D 0 z)))
